title: Pressure-robust and quasioptimal Discontinuous Galerkin discretisations of the $p$-Stokes problem
summary: In the present paper, we propose Local Discontinuous Galerkin (LDG) approximations for a nonlinear system of $p$-Stokes type, having $(p,δ)$-structure. On the basis of the primal formulation, we prove well-posedness and stability (a priori estimates) of the methods under truly minimal regularity assumptions. We show that the first method possesses a pressure-robust and quasi-optimal error estimate, and discuss its consequences.
